<style>
main h2.font-mono.uppercase{font-family:var(--font-display-face),serif!important;font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.2!important;letter-spacing:0!important;text-transform:none!important;color:var(--fg)!important;font-weight:700!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:9px!important;padding-top:10px!important}
main h2.font-mono.uppercase::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;flex:none;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--accent);opacity:.85}
main h2.font-mono.uppercase em{font-family:var(--font-mono-face,ui-monospace),monospace!important;font-size:10.5px!important;font-weight:400!important;letter-spacing:.14em!important;color:var(--accent-text)!important}
main h2.font-mono.uppercase + span{align-self:flex-end;padding-bottom:2px}
[data-rail-news] .grid{grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr)!important;padding-left:14px!important;padding-right:14px!important;column-gap:12px!important;align-items:start!important}
[data-rail-news] [data-feed-actions]{grid-column-start:2!important;grid-row-start:auto!important;margin-top:5px!important;justify-content:flex-start!important;gap:8px!important}
[data-rail-news] [data-feed-two]{flex-direction:row!important;align-items:center!important}
[data-rail-news] .row-span-2{grid-row:span 2/span 2!important;align-self:flex-start!important}
[data-rail-news] h2 a{font-size:12px!important}
@media (max-width:639px){main h2.font-mono.uppercase + span{display:none}}
[data-rail-news] h2{white-space:nowrap}
</style>
